<!-- composer-drop-highlight-proof -->
## Visual proof

New Session composer, 1056×740, dark theme. Actual production-bundled Control UI with synthetic Gateway responses and a browser-dispatched image file drag. Before: base 38a0e8dcd83ec04a63a944b46b6c920b45b7e3fd. After: ca91749cf8d1ba92875a21d2ae789c1b08a7e555. Native OS drag initiation and live model execution are not covered.

### Clean comparison

Before

![Before: image-drop tint appears on the context tray below the message box](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fc7051ac-326d-4f16-9686-96951640c4a3)

After

![After: image-drop tint covers the message surface and leaves the context tray unchanged](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/46d8f531-0bee-4413-87ae-b5ea47a6cb7b)

### Annotated comparison

Before

![Before: the incorrect highlighted tray is outlined](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d17f58d2-d532-41dc-a979-c631cb84f52b)

After

![After: the intended message surface is highlighted and outlined](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/73271de6-0b7f-4c0b-974f-2c37a765cdc3)

Codex review: needs changes before merge. ## What this changes Moves the New Session image-drop highlight from the composer shell to the message surface. **Example:** Drag pixel.png over a New Session containing “Describe this image.” - **Before:** The context tray beneath the message box receives the tint. - **After:** The message box receives the tint. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🦪 silver shellfish **(2/6)** | Direct visual proof establishes the intended correction, but the introduced dictation regression blocks merge. | | **Proof confidence** | 🦞 diamond lobster **(5/6)** ✨ media proof bonus | Sufficient (screenshot): Inspected clean and annotated screenshots show the changed CSS in the production-bundled New Session page at 1056×740 in dark mode, using synthetic Gateway responses and dispatched image-drag events; native OS dragging and live model execution are outside this visual correction. | | **Patch quality** | 🦪 silver shellfish **(2/6)** | 1 actionable review finding remain. | ## Product **Kind:** Bug fix · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** Dragging an image onto New Session highlights the context tray instead of the message box. **Reason:** The maintainer-authored direction restores the existing attachment affordance with a focused CSS change. ## Merge readiness ⛔ **Needs changes before merge - 1 item remains** This PR fixes the reported highlight placement, but introduces a CSS collision that hides the existing dictation border; repair that regression before merging. **Priority:** P3 **Reviewed head:** `ca91749cf8d1ba92875a21d2ae789c1b08a7e555` ## Before merge - [ ] **Preserve the pseudo-element used by active dictation (P2)** - Starting dictation in New Session adds `agent-chat__input--dictating` to this same element. Its existing animated border uses `::after` in `ui/src/styles/chat/composer.css:87`. This new, more specific selector also owns `::after` and supplies `opacity: 0`, so the dictation border disappears even when no file is being dragged; it also replaces the border's background and geometry. Use an unused paint surface, such as `::before`, for the drop tint and cover active dictation in the browser regression. ## Findings - [P2] Preserve the pseudo-element used by active dictation — `ui/src/styles/new-session.css:820`
Agent review details ### How this fits together The New Session composer handles file drags through shared attachment handlers; CSS presents their active state while attachment ingestion produces previews. ```mermaid flowchart LR A[Image file drag] --> B[Composer shell handlers] B --> C[Active drop attribute] C --> D[Message surface highlight] B --> E[Shared attachment ingestion] E --> F[Attachment preview] ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Keep the shell-wide drop handlers and paint the message-surface tint on an unused pseudo-element while preserving the existing dictation border. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Current-main stacking rules explain the misplaced tint, and the supplied before/after browser images demonstrate it; no target code was executed during this read-only review. Is this the best way to solve the issue? Moving the existing overlay is appropriately small, but its destination must avoid the pseudo-element already owned by dictation. Full review comments: - [P2] Preserve the pseudo-element used by active dictation — `ui/src/styles/new-session.css:820` Starting dictation in New Session adds `agent-chat__input--dictating` to this same element. Its existing animated border uses `::after` in `ui/src/styles/chat/composer.css:87`. This new, more specific selector also owns `::after` and supplies `opacity: 0`, so the dictation border disappears even when no file is being dragged; it also replaces the border's background and geometry. Use an unused paint surface, such as `::before`, for the drop tint and cover active dictation in the browser regression. Confidence: 0.99 Overall correctness: patch is incorrect Overall confidence: 0.98 AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [427c8572025e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/427c8572025e099df2674a6bfc2fac74792bf523). ### Provenance checked - `New Session attachment-drop overlay` keeps the original intent (da10827439a41e54c2ffb18cb361ae7dfd204758: Provide the new-session composer with the shared attachment drop pipeline and a matching visual affordance, as documented in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/111530.) - `Raised composer and context tray` keeps the original intent (e80a6dd9fdb4c7ce724472dd5d1b216afb4e70a7: Group placement controls around the composer while keeping compact menus and usable controls, as documented in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/197820; the patch preserves that layout.) ### Testing Proof path: shipped entry point. ### Security None. ### Evidence Acceptance criteria: - node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.ui-e2e.config.ts --configLoader runner ui/src/e2e/file-drop-guard.e2e.test.ts - pnpm lint:ui:styles - git diff --check What I checked: - **Introduced change:** The pinned introduction diff changes two CSS selectors and adds a browser regression scenario; it does not change drag handlers or attachment admission. ([`ui/src/styles/new-session.css:820`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/ca91749cf8d1ba92875a21d2ae789c1b08a7e555/ui/src/styles/new-session.css#L820), [ca91749cf8d1](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ca91749cf8d1ba92875a21d2ae789c1b08a7e555)) - **Existing dictation paint owner:** The shared dictation border already occupies .agent-chat__input--dictating::after, and NewSessionComposer applies that class during dictation; the new selector overrides its background, inset, stacking, and opacity. ([`ui/src/styles/chat/composer.css:87`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/ca91749cf8d1ba92875a21d2ae789c1b08a7e555/ui/src/styles/chat/composer.css#L87), [ca91749cf8d1](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ca91749cf8d1ba92875a21d2ae789c1b08a7e555)) - **Inspected visual proof:** The clean and annotated images at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/200758#issuecomment-6958175579 visibly demonstrate the corrected tint in the production-bundled UI with synthetic Gateway responses and browser-dispatched file drags. ([`ui/src/e2e/file-drop-guard.e2e.test.ts:49`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/ca91749cf8d1ba92875a21d2ae789c1b08a7e555/ui/src/e2e/file-drop-guard.e2e.test.ts#L49), [ca91749cf8d1](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ca91749cf8d1ba92875a21d2ae789c1b08a7e555)) - **Current-main behavior and history:** Fetched main retains the shell overlay. https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/111530 introduced its attachment affordance; https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/197820 subsequently introduced the raised message surface and context tray. ([`ui/src/styles/new-session.css:819`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/427c8572025e099df2674a6bfc2fac74792bf523/ui/src/styles/new-session.css#L819), [427c8572025e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/427c8572025e099df2674a6bfc2fac74792bf523)) - **Failed CI remains unattributed:** https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/44156011139/job/134297928654 reports a Mermaid expansion assertion failure at markdown-mermaid-expansion.browser.test.ts:27; ci-gate reflects that failure.
